title: THE SEED TREE — Stable Semantic Substreams
promise: One root seed can grow an arbitrarily large procedural world without a new sibling reshuffling anything that already exists.
stakes: Today MOOR has deterministic streams, but no canonical child-stream address. Without one, composition order can leak into identity and future adapters can invent incompatible naming rules.
click: Every procedural branch gets an address, not a turn in a random-number queue: root seed + semantic key parts → one canonical seed string → the existing streamFrom().

selected_by.reason: PG-03 is the current deterministic highest-scoring eligible unfinished slice after verified DT-06.

slice.name: Seed derivation standard
slice.deliverable: Named sub-seed scheme compatible with current seed-rng/codec.

existing_machinery.use: Existing FNV-1a → mulberry32 stream remains the RNG. PG-03 does not modify it.
PG-02 already carries the scheme identifier; PG-03 makes that identifier executable and validated.
Existing recipe contract already requires a scheme field.
Current inventory records seed-rng as verified D3 machinery; adapters come later in PG-04.

locked_values.key_input: one string or ordered array of semantic key parts

value_rationale.why: Already emitted by PG-02 normalizeRecipe(), so standardizing it adds meaning to an existing datum instead of inventing a parallel field.
A namespace + explicit version prevents a future derivation algorithm from silently reinterpreting v1 seed strings.
Array framing is unambiguous: ['ab','c'] and ['a','bc'] serialize differently; punctuation and Unicode remain data instead of delimiters.
Hierarchy is semantic data. ['terrain','ridge'] is intentionally distinct from ['ridge','terrain']; sibling creation order is absent from the formula.
streamFrom() already owns FNV-1a + mulberry32. Hashing again would create a second RNG contract and hide lineage.
An empty semantic identity makes accidental unnamed streams indistinguishable from deliberate branches.

SeedSubstreamDescriptor.invariant: seed_string depends only on root_seed + ordered semantic key_parts + scheme version; never on sibling count, generation order, wall clock, UI order, or prior draws.

compatibility.authority: none; seed derivation creates no production/Funnel authority

build_steps.title: Add the semantic-key framing core
build_steps.done_state: MoorSeedSubstream exposes version, scheme, prefix, describe(), seed(), and stream(); it owns no RNG algorithm.

build_steps.title: Make ProceduralRecipe fail closed on unknown schemes
build_steps.done_state: Recipes still default to semantic-key-v1, but any other non-empty scheme now fails validation instead of silently passing.

build_steps.title: Define the scheme as data in the existing procedural contract

invariants: same root_seed + same ordered key_parts => same seed_string
different semantic key paths => different framed seed_string before RNG hashing
adding/reordering unrelated sibling branches does not change an existing branch seed_string
no Date.now(), Math.random(), sequence index, sibling count, prior draw count, or UI order participates

build_steps.done_state: The compact machine-readable schema states exactly how semantic-key-v1 is formed and what is forbidden.
verification: invariants explicitly forbid sequence index and prior draw count

build_steps.title: Prove locality, framing, compatibility and recipe enforcement
required_assertions: identical root/key path returns identical seed string
Unicode and punctuation round-trip through JSON framing
terrain branch seed is unchanged before/after adding unrelated vegetation sibling
different root seed changes seed string
verbatim reference streamFrom(derivedSeed) gives identical first 16 draws across two runs
PG-02 recipe validator accepts semantic-key-v1 and rejects unknown-v9
source contains no Date.now() and no Math.random()
build_steps.done_state: One deterministic test demonstrates branch locality and current RNG compatibility without modifying a generator.

claims.claim: Sibling insertion cannot perturb an existing branch seed.
claims.assertion: Compute terrain seed, compute unrelated vegetation seed, recompute terrain seed; strict equality.

claims.claim: The framing is structurally unambiguous before hashing.
PG-03 reuses the existing RNG instead of replacing it.
claims.assertion: seed-substream-core.js contains no mulberry32/hashSeed implementation and stream() requires injected streamFrom.

claims.claim: Derivation is independent of time and uncontrolled randomness.
claims.assertion: seed-substream-core.js contains neither Date.now nor Math.random.
core exports data/seed helpers only; no Funnel receipt, release, Git, worker, or production mutation method exists.

non_goals: Do not modify hashSeed, mulberry32, streamFrom, SeedCodec, or generator algorithms.
Do not adapt terrain/vegetation/effects/struct generators yet; that is PG-04.
Do not claim FNV-1a is cryptographic or collision-free; PG-03 prevents semantic framing collisions, not the underlying 32-bit hash's theoretical collisions.
Do not migrate existing recipes automatically.
Do not make a seed or recipe an execution/release authority.
acceptance: semantic-key-v1 is executable as one canonical framing formula.
The existing streamFrom/hashSeed/mulberry32 implementation is reused unchanged.
Sibling insertion/order does not enter the derivation formula.
ProceduralRecipe rejects unknown sub-seed scheme identifiers.
Every material claim has an executable assertion.
No generator adapter or production release is implied by the blueprint.
